notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Demo Updates:
[list]
[*] The demo has been extended a little to let more background info be explained 
[*] The main menu was updated to look better and more interesting.
[/list]

The story's coming along well! I haven't been posting any dev log's recently on social medias but I am still working hard on the game behind the scenes, I hope you all enjoy the elements I showed off so far and enjoy the game when it comes out!

I am running a Kickstarter campaign so that I can commit more time to working on the game. Check it out if you are interested or want to support the game! 

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crashlandfantasy/crash-land-fantasy-si-fi-fantasy-adventure-story-game
